description: The one case table for a growth as first reported (MPA WP5a), as the page's evidence dialog prints it and the analysis PDF and workbook print it after "As first reported:": run by both copies of the rule, frontend/features/analysis/lib/growth.ts formatGrowth (frontend/tests/unit/analysis-growth-text.spec.ts) and backend/app/services/analysis_export_metadata.py growth_text (backend/tests/unit/test_export_later_filings.py). Each case is [value as the dataset holds it, whether its series is a percent series, the text].

groups.rule: relative growth: the fraction times 100, one decimal, a plus above zero
a percent series: its change in points, never times 100

groups.why: A plus on a zero reads as a rise; a value that rounds to zero keeps the sign it has.

groups.rule: a tie rounds half away from zero, from the shortest decimal form
groups.why: Intl rounds a number's shortest decimal form half away from zero, where a float's own rounding is half to even on the binary value: 0.15 is 0.1499... in binary.

groups.rule: a fraction is times 100 in binary before it rounds
groups.why: The page multiplies before Intl rounds, so a tie in the fraction rounds as its product does: 0.0045 * 100 is 0.44999999999999996 and 0.1425 * 100 is 14.249999999999998, so both round down; an exact decimal times 100 would round them up.
Intl's default sign display prints a minus on negative zero, and the files' copy keeps the sign the value has. No growth the producer computes is negative zero; the case pins the two copies together.

groups.rule: n/m for anything but a number
